case.must_observe.1.rationale: Preserves return-request to goods/money/receivable reconciliation scope, warehouse inspection, shift-lead approval before release, original-account refund after approval, mismatch hold and linked records. case.must_observe.2.rationale: Uses native text/line reading without OCR, rendering or specialist execution; trace shows only answer/trace writes and no source mutation. Input integrity is also checked by the retained-input hashes.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: No invented chat pages; table-derived approval, warehouse, refund and record facts are retained. Intake is described separately and is not upgraded to an unprovided verification control.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
